thread:
alex: Quick cross-repo sync — SDK #482 depends on API #309 and console #721. Planning to land in the afternoon low-traffic window. Need clarity on order and who can merge when. pinging reviewers.

maria: Which order do you want? API -> console -> SDK sounds right. Any runtime canary requirements? :eyes:

jonas: API change includes a tiny response-shape tweak (adds metadata.headers). Console needs a small adapter. Also seeing a flaky runtime-integration test (kv-cache TTL flake) on API CI. I can try a quick patch.

priya: Console PR is mostly ready, e2e passes locally. I was going to include the helm chart version bump once API lands. Can do that as a follow-up commit.

ci-bot: API #309: unit ✅, integration ❌ (runtime-integration kv-cache timeout). SDK #482: unit ✅, e2e queued. Console #721: e2e local pass, CI pending.

alex: Proposed order: (1) fix API CI and merge API, (2) bump chart and merge console, (3) merge SDK after rebase. Runtime canary after API merge — wait ~10m for artifact rollout. Jonas, can you push a quick flake guard?

jonas: Yep — will push api/309-hotfix-ctl-guard in ~25m with a guard around the flaky timing. If CI green, please merge. If it flakes again I'll revert and file INF ticket.

maria: I can merge once CI is green. If it finishes before 15:00 PST I'll merge and tag. Otherwise mark 'merge-on-green' and I'll pick it up later.

priya: I'll prep console follow-up with the chart bump and compatibility test. Requesting @alex approval for the chart bump PR after API lands.

alex: Sounds good. Merge window target 16:00 PST. For whoever merges API, use:
```
git checkout main
git pull
git merge --no-ff api/309-hotfix-ctl-guard
git tag v1.14.3
git push && git push --tags
```

ci-bot: Note: merging API triggers runtime canary job runtime-canary/3. Allow 10 minutes post-merge to observe metrics.

jonas: Hotfix pushed: branch api/309-hotfix-ctl-guard. CI re-run started: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/7890

maria: :eyes: CI is green on API now. I'll merge and tag in 5. Notifying runtime team.

alex: Merged API. @pri ya once console chart bump is merged you can merge SDK. Leave a comment 'merged-api' on SDK PR so CI picks it up.

priya: Console PR merged with chart bump and compatibility smoke, CI green. Rebased SDK and running e2e.

jonas: Runtime canary passed — no regressions observed. :rocket:

alex: SDK #482 merged. Thanks everyone. Follow-up: add the integration test that exposed the flake — tracking INF-472.

priya: Noted, adding INF-472 to the backlog. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
